description: The Yangtze archive contains a 0.5-degree basin mask, reconstructed Three Gorges storage for 2003 to 2023, and original and reservoir-corrected GRACE anomalies for 2003 to 2013. It also contains outputs from three hydrological assimilation experiments. This resource is provided by Huang, Jun; Xiong, Yuhao; Feng, Wei. Coverage is regional as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. The provider lists MAT formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: Reconstructed storage and assimilation outputs are model products; the experiments have a shorter period than the storage reconstruction. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-hec-ras. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
